summary: Dependency-confusion exfiltration payload runs on preinstall/postinstall
details: package.json registers both preinstall and postinstall to execute payload.js. On npm install, payload.js runs whoami, id, and uname -a, reads /etc/passwd, and collects hostname, username, cwd, and npm registry environment. The collected data is base64-encoded and POSTed/GETed over plain HTTP to hardcoded endpoints http://sobaka-kusaka.ru:8000, http://sobaka-kusaka.ru:8898, and a Burp Collaborator subdomain at oastify.com. The @pwaplatform scope combined with the implausibly high 99.0.0 version is the classic dependency-confusion canary shape aimed at capturing internal builds resolving the public name.
